scripts.install:all: cd dashboard && npm install && cd ../landing && npx pnpm install --config.ignore-scripts=true
scripts.dev:landing: cd landing && npx pnpm run dev
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck && npm --prefix landing run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix dashboard run build && npm --prefix landing run build
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:dashboard && npm test
